items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: The interviewee (Lionel Ferbos) does not speak in the provided context. The mention of 'Pinky' is made by the Interviewer, who states 'I left y'all at the Happy Land'. There is no evidence in the text that Lionel Ferbos personally knew, met, or worked with Pinky.

ctx.x: Well that's when I went to the Happy Land and then. You went to the Happy Land and then. Again, I went back to the Happy Land.
Yeah, and I went there with y'all. And then when Pinky got the job at the Melody Inn for this other fellow, I left y'all at the Happy Land and I got another band and went back in the Melody Inn.
Well who did you work with at the Happy Land?
